description: Polymer chemistry decomposed. Step-growth vs chain-growth polymerization, free radical + cationic + anionic + coordination, controlled radical (ATRP, RAFT), copolymers, crystallization, melt processing, conductive polymers, biodegradable polymers.

sub_mechanisms.name: step_growth_condensation
sub_mechanisms.definition: A-A + B-B → polymer. Each step: small molecule (water) released.
sub_mechanisms.why: Polyester (PET), nylon, polycarbonate. Slow MW build-up. Stoichiometric balance critical.

sub_mechanisms.name: chain_growth_addition
sub_mechanisms.definition: Initiator → active site → adds monomers sequentially. No byproduct.
sub_mechanisms.why: Polyethylene, polystyrene, polypropylene. Fast MW growth. Different kinetics from step.

sub_mechanisms.name: free_radical_polymerisation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Initiator → radical → propagation → termination. Most common industrial.
sub_mechanisms.why: PE, PVC, PS, PMMA. Tolerant of impurities. Cost: broad MWD, branching, hard to control.

sub_mechanisms.name: anionic_polymerisation
sub_mechanisms.why: Narrow MWD, block copolymers. Used for engineering polymers. Sensitive to water + impurities.

sub_mechanisms.name: Ziegler_Natta_coordination
sub_mechanisms.definition: Ti-based catalyst. Stereospecific. Linear PE, isotactic PP.
sub_mechanisms.why: Nobel 1963. HDPE + iPP industrial standard. Modern: metallocene catalysts (better control).

sub_mechanisms.name: ATRP_controlled_radical
sub_mechanisms.definition: Atom Transfer Radical Polymerisation. Reversible activation via Cu catalyst.
sub_mechanisms.why: Narrow MWD, controlled architectures, functional polymers. Combines radical tolerance + control. Modern.

sub_mechanisms.name: RAFT_polymerisation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Reversible Addition-Fragmentation chain Transfer. Chain transfer agent enables control.
sub_mechanisms.why: Wide monomer scope, water tolerant. Standard modern controlled polymerisation.

sub_mechanisms.name: block_copolymers
sub_mechanisms.definition: Distinct polymer blocks connected. SBS, SEBS thermoplastic elastomers.
sub_mechanisms.why: Microphase separation gives unique properties. TPEs combine thermoplastic processing + rubber elasticity.

sub_mechanisms.name: polymer_crystallisation
sub_mechanisms.definition: Chains fold into lamellae. Spherulitic growth. Tm + Tc distinct.
sub_mechanisms.why: Crystallinity determines properties. iPP semi-crystalline; aPP amorphous. Process control.

sub_mechanisms.name: conductive_polymers
sub_mechanisms.definition: Polyacetylene, polyaniline, PEDOT. π-conjugated backbones. Conductivity from doping.
sub_mechanisms.why: Nobel 2000. OLEDs, sensors, antistatic coatings. Modern: PEDOT:PSS widely used.

sub_mechanisms.name: biodegradable_polymers
sub_mechanisms.definition: PLA, PHA, PCL. Designed to hydrolyse/enzymatically degrade.
sub_mechanisms.why: Environmental drivers. PLA from corn (compostable). PHA bacteria-produced. Different end-of-life path.

sub_mechanisms.name: polymer_melt_processing
sub_mechanisms.definition: Above Tm: viscous fluid. Injection mold, extrude, blow mold. Shear thinning.
sub_mechanisms.why: Standard plastic manufacturing. Rheology determines processability. Foundation of polymer engineering.

derivation_rules.name: chain_growth_high_MW_early
then: high MW polymer forms early in reaction
derivation_rules.why: Each initiator: one polymer chain. Grows rapidly. Step-growth: only at high conversion. Standard kinetic distinction.

derivation_rules.name: controlled_radical_for_narrow_MWD
then: controlled radical (ATRP, RAFT) outperforms free radical
derivation_rules.why: Free radical: PDI > 2. Controlled: PDI ~1.05-1.2. Critical for some applications + research. Modern toolkit.

derivation_rules.name: stereoregularity_determines_crystallinity
derivation_rules.why: Regular structure packs into crystal lattice. iPP crystalline; aPP gummy + non-crystalline. Foundation polymer chemistry.

derivation_rules.name: block_copolymer_microphase_separation
derivation_rules.why: Thermodynamics: phase separate; chemistry: blocks tethered → microphase. Nanometer scale. Foundation of self-assembly.

derivation_rules.name: Ziegler_Natta_revolutionised_polyolefins
if: polyethylene + polypropylene need to be linear/stereoregular
derivation_rules.why: Pre-ZN: branched LDPE only. ZN: HDPE + iPP at scale. Now: half of all plastic. Nobel 1963.
